august 16, 2019: the title track of lover arrived a week ahead of the album — a waltz she wrote alone at the piano. her pitch: the last two people on a dance floor at 3 a.m., swaying. recorded in about six hours.
📷 Michael Hicks / CC BY 2.0

longlivets.com/?era=lover&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=on-this-day
why: Calendar slot 2026-08-16 15:00Z X, heartbeat:on-this-day, hook "the date" — a genuine dated Vault match, so the calendar’s symbol-thread fallback is not needed. Source: the Vault Lover item "Lover, the waltz she wrote alone" (2019-08-16, sourced Wikipedia + Rolling Stone): written solo late at the piano, released a week before the album as its third single, recorded with Jack Antonoff at Electric Lady in about six hours, and her own pitch for the sound — "just the last two people on a dance floor at 3 a.m. swaying". Second Lover post in the window (08-13 ran Cruel Summer); different pillar and subject, three days apart. | 2026-08-12 Taylor-photo standard (issue #2031, Joey directive): attached a real credited photograph of Taylor from the repo corpus (apps/web/lib/longlive/lenses.ts), rehosted under /social/library/photos/. Campaign renamed to a STORY-UNIQUE value: findPostedDuplicate treats same platform+campaign as an already-posted duplicate, so the old thematic bucket campaigns (heartbeat:*) would have false-skipped every post in a bucket after its first one landed. | 2026-08-12 PR #2043 review: the visible credit line had been omitted for length, which for THIS image is an actual licence breach rather than a stylistic gap — it is the one cleanly-licensed photo in the set (Michael Hicks, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia), and CC BY's single condition is attribution. Body trimmed by 27 weighted chars (dropped "late,", "her pitch for the sound" → "her pitch", "it took about six hours to record" → "recorded in about six hours") to fit "📷 Michael Hicks / CC BY 2.0" above the link; every sourced fact is retained. Now 266 weighted, inside the ≤270 house rule. The general fix — credit that renders without spending body characters — is the X alt-text follow-up (mediaCredit is validated in CI but never read by the poster).
